headline: Recommends wood pyrolysis power deal at McNeil and new rate changes; approves $741,500 insurance renewal.
summary: Public comment focused on a proposed 2.2-megawatt wood pyrolysis demonstration unit at McNeil, bought through a 20-year power purchase agreement with Vermont Renewable Gas. After an executive session, a 4-to-0 vote recommended that agreement to the Board of Finance and City Council. Earlier, a tariff package was recommended, and an insurance renewal was approved at a premium of up to $741,500.
decisions: Recommended City Council approval of seven tariff changes, including a new HVAC load rate and a battery pilot.
Recommended the wood pyrolysis power purchase agreement to the Board of Finance and City Council, 4-0.
Approved the property, boiler and machinery insurance renewal with a not-to-exceed premium of $741,500, 4-0.
discussion: Wood pyrolysis project: Members asked about costs, emissions, and risks. Staff said stack carbon dioxide would be about 60% lower than McNeil wood combustion, and the developer would carry financing and permitting risk. Public speakers opposed the project, citing emissions and fire risk.
Home EV charging credit: Members discussed a change that would pay a pro-rated credit when at least 75% of charging is off-peak. Staff estimated about $22,000 more in credits each year.
Power factor penalty: Members asked whether the change would hurt customers. Staff said it would lower the penalty for some seasonal users and reduce utility revenue by about $17,000.
Insurance renewal: Members asked whether a property appraisal could lower the premium. Staff said appraisals cost $10,000 to $15,000 and sometimes cut that line by 10 to 20 percent.

decision_evidence.quote: Burlington Electric Department requests that the Electric Commission recommend the City Council approve its filing of several tariff amendments... Okay, that passes.
I move to approve and recommend the wood pyrolysis proposal to Board of Finance, City Council, as presented. ... Okay, it passes 4 to 0.

I move to authorize the general manager of Burlington Electric Department or their designee to execute the property boiler and machinery insurance coverage renewal contract with AIG Zurich StarTech Aegis... with a not-to-exceed premium of $741,500... It carries four to zero.
